verdict.rationale: Railway's marketing states "All logs in one place. Spot issues without switching tools," which matches the story's core directly. Related docs show the Railway Agent inspecting deployments, diagnosing build failures, and reading logs from Slack, which supports a unified log view. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that build, deploy, and runtime logs are each covered in the single view; in-depth first-party log docs beyond a marketing tagline; independent or hands-on corroboration.
